name: Regenerate
description:
Casting time: 1 minute.

You touch a creature and transfer some of your Symbiotes to it, stimulating its natural healing. The creature regains 4d8+HEART Endurance and halves its current Injury.

For the next hour, the Symbiotes continue to mend the creature’s body. It regains 1 Endurance at the start of each of its turns, or 12 Endurance per minute spent outside of combat. At the end of each minute, it also halves its current Injury.

Any severed digits or limbs regrow over the course of the hour. If you possess the severed part and hold it in place while casting this spell, it reattaches instantly.

Describe the regeneration.
